record_title: Exact approximation-number power law for two-subspace alternating projections
provenance: For two orthogonal projections, the Halmos two-subspace model makes the nth alternating-projection error have generalized singular-value profile C^(2n-1), while the one-step error has profile C; spectral min-max then gives the exact all-k approximation-number power law.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge and excludes Halmos' two-subspace theorem, principal-angle and singular-value descriptions of products of projections, and the classical Kayalar-Weinert operator-norm formula. The Böttcher-Spitkovsky survey was not exhaustively inspected in full, so an equivalent all-k formulation under canonical-angle terminology remains a residual risk.
